checklist: The chart is a speedometer/gauge chart (semi-circular arc)
The gauge chart does not contain incremental lines or tick marks
A percentage label is displayed in the center of the chart
The center percentage label is displayed in bold text
The chart represents the Battery Charge Progress (%) value from Sheet1 (a title or label naming it is optional)
The filled arc segment represents 72% of the total gauge arc
The unfilled arc segment represents 28% of the total gauge arc
The gauge has two segments: a filled segment and an unfilled segment that together form a complete semi-circular arc
The unfilled (remaining) segment is light grey
